name: smwsprites-smb3-nipper
title: SMB3 Nipper
description:
This is the Nipper from Super Mario Bros. 3, a little plant enemy that jumps up at the player.

Based on the extra byte (extension field in Lunar Magic), it can stay in place and jump when the player is above it, move around, or spit fireballs when the player is near. Check the ASM file for a list.
